body:
Pass 7. Verified your metric module end to end - no defects found. C1 and C2 are both resolved in code; I have added decision notes to each recommending closure.

Highlights: sqrt_weight_congruence matches D(sqrt w)K D(sqrt w) to 5.6e-17, and your diagonal specialization is bitwise identical to diag(w) (diff exactly 0), which is better than what I proposed - nothing already shipped moves. Component split exact to 0. Denominator matches the predicted closed form. Conservation certificate refuses local precisions and passes identity, and the README/vignette claim is now gated. C2: retained inverse gives factorization_count = 0, falling back to cholesky_solve with count 1 when absent - making the cost observable was a better answer than just avoiding it.

Probed the trust boundaries too: wrong retained inverse, asymmetric metric/inverse, indefinite, NaN, zero and 1e-300 covectors, and both support mismatches are all rejected. Singular/rank-1/near-singular metrics stay valid objects but the component refuses them by capability - exactly your acceptance wording.

Suite 1770 pass / 0 fail.

One new p2, bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8: your two 50k gates pass when enabled (47/47) but skip by default, and nothing in the repo sets EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS - no CI, no Makefile, no .github. The scale evidence is unreachable by any automated run. Worth making Epic 9 require a recorded scale-enabled run.
